steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: An open-loop control system has no feedback; the output is not checked against the desired value, so errors are not corrected automatically. | Key Fact: A closed-loop (feedback) control system measures the output and compares it with the set point, adjusting the input to reduce any error. | Key Fact: Closed-loop control uses a sensor to measure the output, a comparator to find the error, and a controller to correct it. | Key Fact: A microcontroller is a single-chip computer containing a processor, memory and input/output peripherals for embedded control.
